text: In German, dates are written day, month, year: 3.10.2026 or 03.10.2026. A full stop after the day or month shows that it is an ordinal number: 3. means dritte.
The week starts on Monday. Samstag is Saturday; in the north and east you may also hear Sonnabend. 3 October is a public holiday in Germany, the Tag der Deutschen Einheit (German Unity Day).
